title: Verwijzing naar de data van: Brabants Dagblad readers jury
descriptions: Study among readers of local Dutch newspapers on the effects of readers jury's on perceptions and attitudes toward crime and law practice. When the public receives better factual information about the workings of the criminal law system and specific cases, she will be more positive about the courts and judges as well as demand less severe punishments than when the public does not receive this information.

Data available in consultation with Nederlands Studiecentrum Criminaliteit en Rechtshandhaving. Please contact the datamanager [datamanagement@Nederlands Studiecentrum Criminaliteit en Rechtshandhaving.nl]

data_sources: Subscribers to the Brabants Dagblad, Limburgs Dagblad en De Limburger (N=1386). Before the appearance of the first newspaper jury in the Brabants Dagblad 2000 subscribers to this paper and 2000 subscribers to the Limburgs Dagblad and De Limburger received a questionnaire. One year later, afer 20 readers juries had appeared in the Brabants Dagblad, the same participants received an identical questionnaire.
